subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the

messages.text: At Pour 3, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 20 00 required compaction density for the structural fill under the building pad -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? No particular urgency here -- please review at your convenience. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
